summary: Recent headlines reflect ongoing concerns about federal control over D.C., including discussions of National Guard deployment and corporate positions on D.C.-related legislation, while some elected officials have reaffirmed commitment to statehood efforts. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.
